name: Türje (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of medium blue, white and medium blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the round seal of Türje: the Virgin and Child within a yellow ring inscribed in Latin, above a scroll inscribed TÜRJE 1234.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
